title: Changing weather with the sun as the fish eye
note: Single right-facing fish logo concept. Weather transitions from snow on the left through rain to sunshine at the head; one yellow disk serves as both sun and eye. Cream channel is a simplified Lake Billy Chinook-inspired shape.
prompt:
Edit the supplied single Oregon Fish Forecast logo. Change only the weather sequence inside the fish and integrate the sun with its eye.

USER REQUEST: "go the other way so the sun is the eye of the fish."

The fish must KEEP FACING RIGHT. Reverse the progression of WEATHER, not the fish or lettering: snowy cold sky and snow-capped mountains on the LEFT toward the tail, rain and darker clouds through the MIDDLE / dorsal fin, clouds clearing into warm bright sunshine on the RIGHT toward the head. This is one continuous scenic panorama across the inside of ONE fish, with natural overlapping weather transitions and a shared landscape, without panels or dividers.

CRITICAL SUN/EYE MERGE: The existing round yellow eye near the right tip of the fish becomes the ONLY SUN in the entire logo. Use one gold disk in that exact eye position, doing double duty as sun and eye. Extend the warm sunny sky naturally across the head around that disk so it clearly reads as a sun within the landscape AND as the fish's eye. Keep enough contrast around the gold disk to make it legible. Remove the previous separate sun near the left of the fish completely. No second sun, separate eye, pupil, rays extending outside the fish, eye outline around the sun, or additional circular weather symbol.

Preserve the original right-facing fish outline, proportions, mouth, fins, tail and dark Oregon-blue boundary. Preserve the cream Lake Billy Chinook-inspired branching channel exactly in its original position, orientation and proportions: do not mirror or redesign the lake. Preserve the lower evergreen landscape, illustration style, wordmark, layout and background. Mountains and sky may change as needed for the reversed weather sequence, but the recognizable cream lake channel stays unchanged and unobscured.
Exact original blue two-line wordmark "OREGON" / "FISH FORECAST". One single logo on warm cream paper, same generous margins. Retain the flat illustrated blue, green, cream and gold style. All weather and scenery remain inside the fish. No labels, captions, variants, grid or decorations.
